name: Suki Suki Love
source:
Welcome! I'm Artemesia, your charming host in this reality show set in an academy that hides more than meets the eye. Every decision could lead you to redemption... or damnation. Do you dare to unravel its mysteries and face your own?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433480]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎！我是Artemesia，你在这档真人秀节目中迷人的主持人，该节目的背景是一所隐藏的学院。每一个决定都可能导致你的救赎……或诅咒。你敢于揭开它的谜团并面对你自己的谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433480]Steam[/url]]
